description: The validate workflow swallows its own fetch failure: '.github/workflows/validate.yml' runs 'git fetch origin main || true' before the version-bump guard. The '|| true' means a failed fetch is invisible, and any later step depending on origin/main then operates on a stale ref or a missing one. ASK-514 removed the danger for THIS gate specifically - plugin-version-bump-check.py now refuses an unresolvable --against ref instead of exiting 0 having checked nothing - so the combination is no longer silent. NOT fixed because the remaining question is whether other steps in that workflow depend on the fetch, and removing '|| true' turns a swallowed network blip into a hard CI failure across the fleet. That is a .github/workflows change with fleet blast radius and needs its own measurement of which steps read origin/main, not a drive-by edit. Check git log on validate.yml for why the '|| true' was added before removing it.

Fix is at the dispatch layer: pre-approve Edit(.claude/rules/**) in the worker's permission set, or route rule edits through a script the worker is allowed to run.

description: sp-b3e09376's premise is now STALE and its finding is not: apply-claude-changes.sh is no longer additive-only (ASK-289 added the replace op, REPLACE_OPS), but the two-gate squeeze it named survives in a sharper form. PR #321 review round 4, four unaddressed minors/nits on q-system/hooks/auto-commit.py (merged on APPROVE WITH NITS): (1) the lock guard runs BEFORE get_changed_files, so a clean tree prints 'committing nothing, the next turn end picks this work up' when there is no work to pick up; (2) another_commit_in_flight has no bounded wait or retry, so a sub-second peer lock costs the whole turn's commit and the 'next turn end' promise is false on a session's LAST turn - kipi-update.sh solves the same problem with a bounded wait it can afford and a Stop hook cannot, so the right shape is probably a short bounded wait, not none; (3) test_a_refusal_reaches_the_channel_the_fleet_wiring_keeps says it fires the hook 'exactly the way the fleet does' while its body captures stderr and omits the '|| true' and async wiring - the assertion is still correct, the docstring overclaims; (4) PR body verification block was left at 44 passed / 7 new after the branch reached 46 / 9.
